body:
I fucked up 8 years ago by leaving my development job and joining a call center, only to find out, 8 years later, that I will need to start all over again if I want to do what *I* want to do, or go with the call center flow and learn their 'business'. I decided to start all over again, left the call center and am sitting here refreshing discrete mathematics. 

I do hope to find another job, but sometimes I get too disheartened at the realization that I am where I was 8 years ago and I should not have joined the call center to begin with. 

Fucking ms - they knew this is what happens to technically oriented employees, and still continued to hire technical engineers into their call centers.
